audit: Carnivores 1998 HUNTDAT/AREAS structural and editor-metadata audit
notes: PASS means PRJ record counts/sequences, nonempty names, duplicate-key and project-flag checks pass; MAP indices are within PRJ counts; RSC model/audio references and allocation constraints pass and RSC reaches exact EOF; and the GRP v1 fixed-record layout, active group references, boolean rotation flags, reserved padding, and exact EOF pass.
Each PRJ/MAP/RSC/GRP input has a SHA-256 digest in the report for reproducibility.
GRP v1 is decoded as 32 fixed texture groups, 32 fixed object groups, and 32 fixed transitive-texture groups; active indices are checked against the corresponding PRJ texture/object totals.
PRJ is treated as the text project/catalog metadata for named textures, objects, fogs, random sounds, ambient sounds, sky flags, and project version.
Owner/hide relationship semantics in TPoint3d/TObj and per-face Next/group/DMask semantics are not validated yet.
The parser mirrors the original loader's fixed-width little-endian Win32 records and should be checked against a working original executable before changing assets.
The original game loader consumes MAP/RSC at runtime; PRJ/GRP are audited as editor/project metadata and are not required by the runtime loader path checked in this source baseline.
The original loader ignores ReadFile success/byte counts; this audit is intentionally stricter and does not modify any input.
